lines: {target}? Green stalks can hide quick trouble. I would stay close enough to hear the bell.
If anyone heads for Bamboo Jungle, tell them: Keep a path cut behind you. I will be at the bell.
Bamboo crowds the eye and the feet. I will remember that from near the bell.
Bamboo Jungle is no small story. Running the wrong way is still running.
I will remember Bamboo Jungle as a green wall that rustles like whispers. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
{target}? Leaves crowd close enough to hide anything. I would stay close enough to hear the bell.

I will remember Jungle as a hot forest that keeps secrets well. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
